title: Nice Buttery Argentinian Lemongrass Empanadas
description: Buttery and crumbly empanadas filled with lemongrass and takrai, perfect for a quick snack or meal, this low sodium dish is cooked to perfection in a tajine clay vessel and glazed for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cold butter, and water to make the empanada dough.
Mix the dough until it forms a ball and then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together chopped lemongrass and takrai.
Roll out the empanada dough and use a cookie cutter or a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the lemongrass and takrai mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with an egg wash.
Place the empanadas in a tajine clay vessel and bake for 25 minutes.
While the empanadas are baking, prepare the glaze by heating it in a saucepan over low heat.
After the empanadas have baked for 20 minutes, brush the tops with the glaze and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
